chunks: Ibn Bukayr said, 'Hariz narrated to me from Bukayr with that.' Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from one of our companions, from Al-Hakam ibn Miskin, from Jamil who said,
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'The man who comes to a close relative (Mahram), where should he be struck with the sword?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'His throat.'

key_terms.ذَاتَ مَحْرَمٍ: A close relative (female) with whom marriage is permanently forbidden

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a man committing incest with a Mahram according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) specifies that the execution method for a man committing adultery with a *Mahram* (close relative) is beheading (*raqabatuhu*). This ruling highlights the severity of incestuous relations in Shia jurisprudence, distinguishing the mode of capital punishment based on the specific nature of the crime and the degree of kinship involved.

en.hubeali:
Ibn Bukeyr said, ‘Hareyz narrated to me, from Bukeyr, with that’.
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Salim, from one of our companions, from Al Hakam Bin Muskeyn, from Jameel who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘The man comes to a Mahram, where should he be struck with the sword?’ Heasws said: ‘His throat’.
